description: Call this when a user asks when a business tax return is due: Form 1065, 1120-S, 1120 or Schedule C (IRS), or the T2 / T1 (CRA). Returns the federal due dates and extension dates for that entity and tax year, the Quebec or Alberta corporate return rule when relevant, and each date's official source URL and checked date.

entity.description: Business type. US: sole_prop, single_member_llc, multi_member_llc, partnership, s_corp, c_corp. Canada: sole_prop or corporation.

jurisdiction.description: A US state or Canadian province: two-letter code (TX, ON), US-TX / CA-ON, or the full name. "CA" means California; use "Canada" or a province code for Canada. "US" or "Canada" alone means federal only.

tax_year.description: The tax year the return covers (e.g. 2025 for returns filed in 2026).

name: check_filing_deadline
title: Check business tax filing deadlines
